text:
Maya R: Quick async check — OptKit milestone status. Need owners for three items by EOD Fri: quant recommendations, batching/caching config, and regression alert playbook. Who can pick which?

Sam T: I can own quant recs. Will run final pass on c4 and int8 sims. ETA Thu.

Indra P: I'll take batching/caching config. Quick Q: should we default KV cache TTL to 10m or 30m? Workloads vary.

Maya R: Prefer 10m for low-latency RW, but expose as feature flag so we can iterate. @ops-bot can we gate via rollout flag? :eyes: 

ops-bot: deploy-flag created: optkit.kv_cache_ttl_seconds (default 600). Rollout policy: 50% -> 100% over 2h.

Lucy G: I'll own the regression alert playbook. Plan is: wire evals -> alert if perf delta >3% OR token-cost spike >15%, with a pager for severity=high. Need golden prompt set.

Sam T: Quick update from sims — int8 gives ~2x memory reduction and +1.5% throughput in most cases, but I hit one failure with long-context chat history prompt (token window > 2048). PR up: https://git.company/repo/pull/482

Indra P: If int8 misbehaves on long context, let's do hybrid: int8 for <=1024 tokens, fallback to fp16 beyond that. That keeps perf wins for short queries without regressing long-context.

Maya R: Agree. Sam, can you add hybrid profile and a rollout knob to config? Also ask @Lucy G to CR the eval thresholds once the golden set is in.

Lucy G: Will review PR tonight and add comments. Also will assemble the golden prompt set (mix of convo history + edge cases) and link it here.

ops-bot: Canary scheduled: optkit-int8-hybrid v2 -> env=canary at 2026-03-20T22:00Z

Sam T: Adding feature 'optkit.quant.mode' values ['fp16','int8','hybrid']. Snippet I'll add to repo:
```yaml
quant:
  mode: hybrid
  int8_max_tokens: 1024
```
Will push change and link PR.

Maya R: Thanks. One more dependency: infra needs CUDA driver >= 540 on staging for the int8 kernels. @infra-team please confirm target window.

Indra P: Heard back — infra aiming for Fri AM. I'll keep this blocked until confirmation done.

Lucy G: :thumbsup: I'll draft the regression playbook and post the doc link here for review.

Maya R: Owners recap: Sam = quant profiles + PR, Indra = batching/caching + infra follow-up, Lucy = regression playbook + golden prompts. I'll coordinate rollout schedule and send calendar invites. Ping here if anything slips. :rocket:

ops-bot: Reminder set: OptKit owners sync in #eng-platform 2026-03-19 09:00 PST
